Element.Description: Current-health threshold for selecting this attack sequence. Sequences 1 through 4 are tested in order using a strict greater-than comparison. Sequence 5 is the fallback and does not test its own threshold.
Lower bound, in seconds, for the attack cooldown selected from the current sequence while the boss is Ing-controlled. Used directly when no random generator is available.
Upper bound, in seconds, for the random attack cooldown selected from the current sequence while the boss is Ing-controlled. MinTimeBetweenSequences supplies the lower bound.
Movement-speed setting copied to the boss during its boss-state update and when it begins pursuing the player while Ing-controlled.

First attack in the Ing-controlled Sandworm's sequence. Values: 0 spit, 1 bomb toss, 2 bomb spread, 3 alternate toss and spread, 4 bomb fountain. If the last attack was neither toss nor spread, choice 3 selects randomly when a random generator is available and otherwise selects toss.
Attack after FirstAttackInSequence. Uses the same choices; a value outside 0 through 4 ends the sequence before this step and returns to FirstAttackInSequence.
Attack after SecondAttackInSequence, followed by a return to FirstAttackInSequence. Uses the same choices; a value outside 0 through 4 ends the sequence before this step.
